done_when: Each delivered event's Next line is worked out from current state, events for items that have since merged are dropped, and each CI line names the workflow and its result, once per workflow and commit

known.title: Queued CI events can report an obsolete result after a rerun

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional — If a workflow fails while Claude is busy, then passes on a rerun of the same commit before delivery, the board updates its result but keeps the same workflow-and-commit event ID. This line does not replace the pending event because its ID is already observed, so delivery still says the workflow failed. The same-commit rerun proof changes check IDs and times but never changes the result, leaving this path untested.
findings.title: Queued CI events can report an obsolete result after a rerun

why: The Claude Code pane delivers Forge events late in bursts, with Next lines worked out when the event happened, and each push gives two bare 'Ci finished' lines
